name: Dry MARTINI
references: C. Arnarez et al., J. Chem. Theory Comput. 11, 260 (2015)
notes: 1 bond rules without coefficients were skipped
converted from moltemplate by CAPS; rules keep moltemplate's order (the last matching rule wins)
CAPS correction: beads have no element (the converter guessed Sc from bead masses)
pair settings from the source (In Init): lj/gromacs 9 to 12 A, coul/gromacs 1e-6 to 12 A, dielectric 15; special_bonds 0 1 1
CAPS correction: 703 pair sigmas were in nm in the source (its epsilons and bonds are converted); multiplied by 10
